_comment: Hatch fill. HatchTool reads context.selected (the closed boundary), so the boundary MUST be selected BEFORE activating Hatch + the commit click. We draw a circle (id 1) as the closed boundary, select it, activate Hatch, then a single click fills it. currentHatchPattern is left nil => SOLID fill (proves the fill region renders). The fill appears as a filled disc; assert shows fillCount goes up and entityCount = 2 (circle + hatch). To show a PATTERNED hatch instead, add before activateTool: {"op":"setOption","field":"currentHatchPattern","value":"ANSI31"}.
